title: Viking Chess
descriptionPlain: Description Modern approach to a traditional subject Decorated with hand-painted 3D insert Perfect gift idea for a chess enthusiast Finest silver One of the most chilling finds from the Viking era was discovered at the beach on the Scottish of Lewis in the earlu 1800s. This extremely important symbol of European civilization is still admired at exhibitions around the world.
